nom: Avène Cicalfate+ Intensive Skin Restorative Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with large pores and breakouts reports tighter-looking pores and fewer breakouts, with no reported oiliness increase from the serum itself.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or chronically dry skin mostly report relief from tightness and dryness with soft, hydrated skin, though a few report the opposite — increased dryness, tightness, or peeling.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report good absorption, no pilling or stickiness, and hydration without new clogging, with one exception reporting a breakout.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including rosacea and perioral dermatitis, describe calming and barrier repair with no stinging, but a minority report their sensitive skin reacted badly with peeling, worsened rosacea, or dermatitis flare-ups.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin reports reduced dryness with continued use.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 35-50 report smoother skin, softened fine lines around the eyes, and firmer-feeling skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report smoother skin and visibly reduced fine lines, particularly around the eyes, within about a week to two months.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, fast-absorbing hydration that lasts through the day and pairs well under moisturizer; one reviewer found it drying and tight instead, especially in cold weather.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive redness generally report visible calming and reduced redness, sometimes after a single use, though one reviewer reports rosacea redness and bumps worsened over weeks of use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe visible barrier repair after damage from retinoids, chemical peels, laser, or Fraxel treatments, with soothing and restored comfort; one reviewer's perioral dermatitis and barrier issues worsened instead and resolved only after stopping the product.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her hormonal cystic acne around her period improved when this was added to her routine.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or comedone-prone skin report no new breakouts or clogging and some improvement in existing blemishes without scarring; a few reviewers report the product caused new breakouts for them.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the serum itself as non-oily, non-greasy and lightweight, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: High price relative to bottle size

extraits.texte: This had zero positive effects on my skin. It feels fine upon application and absorbs well enough, but that's about it in terms of positives. Since adding it to my regimen (the only new thing), my roasacea has been worse (redness and bumps), my perioral dermatitis flared up again after being pretty much resolved for 6+ mos, and my skin just felt dry and uncomfortable. I didn't suspect this serum for quite a while because it's marketed as something to help soothe and moisturize. I am a good 3/4 through the bottle, but finally I realized my skin has been getting worse and worse since adding this product into my night routine. A week after stopping this serum, and my skin is so much calmer, perioral dermatitis nearly fully resolved again, and rosacea bumps gone. I learned if it isn't broke, dont try to fix it. I was trying to add an additinal soothing and moisturizing product to my sensitive skin routine for winter, and it ended up having the total opposite effect. Would not recommend.

I was really excited to try this as I love the Cicalfate+ cream by this brand but I was really disappointed when after 2 days my skin started peeling off and felt extremely dry and thick. This product was the only change. I tested this out twice to be sure that this product was what caused the horrible reaction. If you have dry sensitive skin I would stay away from this product. If I could give this 0 stars I would.

This product saved my skin after months of trying everything. I've realized that my skin is just not meant for retinoids- regardless of formula, sandwich method, starting extremely slow with no other actives etc. After my last stint of trying retinal (used 2x) i developed a rash that I believe to have been perioral dermatitis. I was so red, itchy, and scaly and burned. Basic moisturizers would burn and make it worse, it seems HA made it worse, tried non-dandruff shampoos in case it was fungal acne and made it worse, tried nothing at all and it made it worse. I had this issue going on for months and felt like any moisturizer I used was irritating. Picked this little miracle serum up and within a week the rash was pretty much gone. It didnt sting my super sensitive skin. And it plays well under my makeup since (tends to lean more silocone based)! Also love that it's one of very few moisturizing products I've found that doesnt contain hyaluronic acid. I don't even care that it's expensive- I will continue buying this and raving about it! Please try it!

I am 42 with chronically dry skin, hormonal acne, acne scars, redness, all the fun stuff. I have been using this for a few days now and from the moment i put it on, i feel a rush of hydration and it lasts all day, it feels amazing and very comforting on my skin. I got it on sale and regret not buying more but it's totally worth full price. This serum plays nicely with others. For example, i spray my face with the rose water Mario Badescu spray, use this serum, then Bobbi Brown serum and Bobbi Brown face cream. It's heavenly!!! Cannot recommend enough. Best morning serum.

I enjoyed the fast-absorbing and lightweight nature of this product. I am already a fan of cica for skincare. I struggle with some combination skin with more dryness in the winter months. My skin tends to feel dehydrated and in need of moisture. I also struggle with moisture barrier (keeping moisture in) due to some auto-immune issues that affect my overall skin's health. This product was hydrating and calming. I would definitely add this to my skincare routine!

I have very sensitive skin due to rosacea and this has helped a lot to restore my barrier that was extremely damaged by improper use of retinols. My skin is extremely soft now and some fine lines have even improved. I saw results after about 2 months of consistent use, along with other prescriptions, but I attribute most of the healing on my face to this product!

Background info: i am a women in her early twenties with sensitive and acne prone skin. This product made me break out. Woulnt recommend this produxt because my other avene and physiogel products feel more hydrating without this price tag. Overall its good, just not enough to make me come back for more.
